convert_vrs_to_mp4: convert a VRS file to an MP4 video with optional audio channels and down-sampling
get_timestamp_from_mp4: extract VRS device timestamps from an MP4 file's description metadata tag using ffprobe
save_timestamp_to_mp4: embed a list of VRS device timestamps into an MP4 file's description tag using ffmpeg
Vrs2Mp4Converter_make_frame: generate an RGB frame array for a given MP4 timestamp from a VRS file
Vrs2Mp4Converter_make_audio_data: extract and normalize audio data for a given timestamp from a VRS file
